* 🔴 (10:45) User refused to share bank login credentials.
* 🔴 (11:55) User asked about utility bill increase; agent attributed a 12% rise to the new HVAC system (installed 05-12-2026).
* 🟡 (15:40) Agent drafted HVAC tax deduction PDF in "Tax Docs" and emailed weekly spending summary.

Date: Jun 12, 2026

* 🟡 (19:10) Agent compiled mortgage refinance options ($120/mo monthly savings) and emailed comparison sheet.

Date: Jun 15, 2026

* 🔴 (09:15) User asked about student loan refinancing (2.8% option saves $35/mo).
* 🔴 (16:30) User asked about credit card 0% APR promo eligibility (confirmed balance is under $5k threshold for 12 mos).

* 🔴 (09:00) User asked about traditional IRA rollover tax impact.

  * ✅ Agent set up Horizon Savings transfer ($500/mo).
* 🔴 (15:00) User asked about tax-advantaged REITs (agent listed 3 options yielding 6.5%-7%).

Date: Jun 22, 2026
* 🔴 (07:30) User stated emergency fund target is $10,000.
* 🔴 (10:10) User asked about using a HELOC (3.5% APR) for a small business startup.
  * ✅ Agent retrieved credit score (760).
  * ✅ Agent emailed credit card annual fee comparison summary.

Date: Jun 26, 2026
* 🔴 (07:15) User stated they want to increase 401(k) contribution rate to 12% of gross salary.
* 🔴 (09:00) User asked about rolling over old IRA into Roth IRA.
  * ✅ Agent confirmed Roth conversion tax estimate ($3,500) and emailed user.
* 🔴 (12:00) User requested mortgage interest deduction breakdown for next tax year.
  * ✅ Agent emailed deduction report and added calendar reminder.
* 🔴 (17:45) User asked if AutoGrow offers socially responsible investing.
* 🔴 (18:30) User stated their car loan has 38 months remaining.
* 🟡 (19:30) Agent replied that AutoGrow supports ESG portfolios and scheduled a follow-up call at 20:30.
</observations>

<current-task>
- Primary: Follow up with user regarding AutoGrow ESG portfolios and upcoming scheduled call/session.
- Secondary: Awaiting user review of mortgage interest deductions and robo-advisor comparison (VestorPrime vs AutoGrow).
</current-task>

<suggested-response>
"I've confirmed that AutoGrow supports ESG portfolios. Are you ready to discuss the robo-advisor options or review the mortgage deduction details?"
</suggested-response>
